Professional Law Practice in Nepal

Principled Advocacy & Strategic Legal Counsel

Advising domestic enterprises, property owners, and private individuals before District Courts, High Courts, and the Supreme Court of Nepal.

Our Chambers Philosophy

Founded in Inaruwa, PATHIVARA LAW FIRM SUNSARI is dedicated to providing rigorous, dependable legal advocacy and corporate advisory. Our legal practice is grounded in the recognition that substantive legal success requires disciplined evidentiary analysis long before a dispute enters open court.

Adherence to Nepal Bar Council Standards

We practice in strict compliance with the Nepal Bar Council Act 2050 and the Nepal Bar Council Code of Conduct 2051. We hold that the profession of an advocate is an office of public trust and judicial assistance, not commercial advertising. For this reason:

  • We provide honest, objective assessments of legal risks rather than unrealistic outcome guarantees.
  • We conduct exhaustive limitation (Hadmyad) and evidentiary reviews under the Muluki Civil and Criminal Procedure Codes 2074.
  • We safeguard client communications with uncompromising ethical confidentiality.

Court Jurisdiction & Geographical Scope

Our advocates regularly appear before judicial benches and administrative authorities across Nepal:

  • Supreme Court of Nepal: Constitutional petitions, final appeals, and revision applications.
  • High Courts: High Court Patan (Commercial Bench), High Court Biratnagar, and appellate benches.
  • District Courts: Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Sunsari (Inaruwa), and Morang (Biratnagar).
  • Specialized Tribunals: Debt Recovery Tribunal (DRT), Labour Court, Special Court, and Land Revenue Offices (Malpot).
